newsitem.title: UK: Unilever up on reports of restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Unilever up on reports of restructuring.

text.p: Shares in Unilever jumped on weekend press reports that the Anglo-Dutch consumer goods concern planned to streamline the company's wide-ranging spread of worldwide businesses.
By 1106 GMT, the shares had climbed 10-1/2p to 1280-1/2p.
Unilever's shares have underpeformed the broad market all year. They trended lower from January to mid-April, when the shares hit their lows for the year, and have been rebounding since.

In an interview published in the London Times yesterday, Niall FitzGerald, the new chairman of Unilever's British arm, said the company would wind down or dispose of brands that did not have a chance of being leaders in their markets.
Said one market maker of FitzGerald's comments: "People are quite optimistic. Unilever has been a bit of a sleeping giant. I think there may be more upside for the stock."
